display.purpose: The hero sign, about 11 characters, low in the first viewport.

body.purpose: The lede, held to 68 characters. Notes inherit root weight 440.

label.purpose: The status pill. Film pills share the weight at inherited size.

shadows.name: hairline
shadows.purpose: Resting ring on the line button. It is a hairline, not elevation.

shadows.name: hairline-tape
shadows.purpose: Line button hover. The same inset ring, drawn in route teal.

motion.name: pass
motion.purpose: One 22vh hot-tape segment travels the first screen along the tape, from -20vh to 105vh, then stays at opacity 0.

motion.name: reduced
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion removes the sweep. The standing 2px tape remains.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The route pill. Opens the next step. Hover brightens the fill to hot tape.

components.name: Line Button
components.description: The quiet pill. An inset hairline, redrawn in route teal on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-line { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 1.2rem; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #f3f6f8); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line, rgba(243, 246, 248, 0.16)); font-family: "Pathway Extreme Variable", sans-serif; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.015em; text-decoration: none; } .ds-btn-line:hover { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--tape, #12b5cb); color: var(--tape, #12b5cb); } .ds-btn-line:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--tape, #12b5cb); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Link

components.css: .ds-bar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.35rem 0.75rem; min-height: 4rem; padding: 0.35rem 1.25rem; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ground, #0b0e10) 90%, transparent); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, rgba(243, 246, 248, 0.16)); backdrop-filter: blur(14px); font-family: "Pathway Extreme Variable", sans-serif; } .ds-wordmark { color: var(--ink, #f3f6f8); font-size: 1.35rem; font-weight: 660; font-stretch: 86%; letter-spacing: -0.035em; text-decoration: none; } .ds-lockup { margin: 0; color: var(--mute, #c3ced4); font-size: 0.95rem; } .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; margin-left: auto; } .ds-nav a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 0.75rem; color: var(--mute, #c3ced4); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: var(--ink, #f3f6f8); } .ds-bar-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 1.2rem; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--tape, #12b5cb); color: #062026; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.015em; text-decoration: none; } .ds-bar-btn:hover { background: var(--tape-hot, #9ae7f2); } .ds-wordmark:focus-visible, .ds-nav a:focus-visible, .ds-bar-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--tape, #12b5cb); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Stage Frame

components.css: .ds-frame { position: relative; margin: 0; background: var(--plate, #141a1e); border: 1px solid var(--line, rgba(243, 246, 248, 0.16)); border-radius: 1.25rem; overflow: hidden; } .ds-frame-field { position: relative; height: 9rem; background: var(--plate, #141a1e); } .ds-frame-field::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 14%; right: 22%; top: 62%; height: 4px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--tape, #12b5cb); } .ds-frame-pill { position: absolute; top: 0.85rem; left: 0.85rem; padding: 0.4rem 0.75rem; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--ground, #0b0e10); color: var(--ink, #f3f6f8); border: 1px solid var(--line, rgba(243, 246, 248, 0.16)); font-family: "Pathway Extreme Variable", sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 620; }

narrative.overview:
Gnarly is a night corridor with one teal route. The ground is near-black, the type is Pathway Extreme Variable, and the path is a solid tape. Signs are condensed. Reading text stays at the font's standard width. Chapters run the full width of the viewport. The film and the diagrams sit in rounded frames. Actions are pills.

The palette stays on that one route. A lighter step of the same teal is the primary hover and the single moving segment. One band, the team, turns on a pale slab and deepens the tape so the route still holds. The sticky bar is the same ground, frosted with a 14px blur. Surfaces do not cast shadows.

Motion is one pass. A brighter segment travels down the first screen along the tape and ends. Reduced motion removes that pass. The standing tape stays.
keyCharacteristics: Dark ground, with one pale team slab
One teal tape, deeper on that slab
Pathway Extreme Variable, condensed on the signs
Pills for actions and 1.25rem frames for the film and the stage
One sweep, removed when motion is reduced

rules.name: The One Tape Rule
rules.body: Route teal is the only accent on the night. On the pale slab the tape, the links, and the selection switch to corridor teal. Hot tape is a lighter step of the same route, used for the primary hover and the sweep.

rules.name: The One Slab Rule
rules.body: Team paper is the team band. Every other chapter stays on night ground, and plate is only the field inside a frame.

rules.name: The Condensed Sign Rule
rules.body: The hero, the chapter titles, and the wordmark set stretch under 90% and tracking at -0.035em. Reading text stays at the standard width.

rules.name: The Single Face Rule
rules.body: Pathway Extreme Variable is the only family, including the labels inside the diagrams. The fallback is generic sans-serif.

rules.name: The Full-Measure Rule
rules.body: A chapter is a band across the viewport.

rules.name: The Tape Gutter Rule
rules.body: The standing tape is 2px at the pad edge. Body copy, signs, and the footer clear it by 1.35rem. The corridor diagram bleeds past the gutter, and the tape still runs over it.

rules.name: The Flat Night Rule
rules.body: Surfaces stay flat at rest and on hover. The line button's inset ring is a hairline. Depth comes from night ground, plate, and the one paper slab.

rules.name: The Pill and Frame Rule
rules.body: Actions and labels are pills. The film and the stage are 1.25rem frames. Diagram-only corners stay inside the drawing.

dos: Do keep chapters on night ground, plate inside frames, and team paper on the one pale band.
Do set the hero and chapter signs in Pathway Extreme Variable under 90% stretch, with tracking at -0.035em.
Do park the 2px tape in the pad gutter and inset the type by 1.35rem.
Do use a pill for actions and labels, and a 1.25rem frame for the film and the stage.
Do leave the sweep as a single 2.8s pass, and remove it under prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't add a second accent hue. Hot tape is the lighter step of route teal, and corridor teal is that route on paper.
Don't add a drop shadow, a glow on the tape or the frames, or a second typeface. The bar's 14px blur is the frost on the ground.
Don't wrap the bands in a centered max-width column.
Don't turn the standing tape into a dash, a blur, or a second animated line.
